licences.source: Edition Peters vocal score (Edition Peters Nr. 4474, plate 11446, edited by Georg Schünemann), pages 134–139, bars 1–61 of No. 16
licences.author: Kurt Soldan (1891–1946), piano reduction
licences.notes: Written out from the printed pages: sung lines and piano each read by two independent readers, every disagreement settled on the page by a judge (in two page ranges, pp. 134–136 and 137–139), a separate sweep for dynamics and other marks, then checked bar by bar by a fresh checker (clean). The German singing translation is left out. The piano's groups of three eighths are triplets (the 3 is printed only in bar 1); after “sempre stacc.” in bar 3, wedges are written only where printed (bars 1–2 and 18). Kept as printed: the eighth rest inside Don Alfonso's ri-de-re in bar 48. Playback tempo: a dotted half = 67 (♩ = 200), estimated (just under a minute; no separate timing of this terzetto was found); Mozart gives the words Molto Allegro only.
